concepts.reader_question: Ranh giới rõ trước khi triển khai
concepts.description: CARD-SPECIFIC TARGETED REGENERATION. Prospective technical handoff arrangement BEFORE implementation: blank sending and receiving surfaces are separated by a neutral unnumbered time/context shape, an open reconciliation workspace and a distinct confirmation-owner silhouette. Vary the view to an angled prospective exchange corridor; keep technical implementation unresolved. Express the parties, checking time and responsibility to agree before choosing implementation. Use credible partner semiconductor architecture context and R2 photographic material depth with integrated physical relationship paths; maintain stable header typography, but vary perspective, scene scale and relation arrangement with card meaning. Every record, screen and prop is completely blank. No actual values, ERP/MES prop labels, letters/numbers/punctuation/microglyphs, dates, metrics, results, standalone question marks, ticks/checkmarks/seals, extra heading or completion icons. Print ONLY exact approved artwork fields/category/sequence and official mark once, without added headline punctuation. Frozen declared reference attributes only; never exact reference composition or undeclared direct-edit input. RESERVE TARGETED REPAIR: REMOVE cardboard box entirely; no packaging, tape, tape bands or box-top surfaces. Use entirely plain blank smooth record surfaces with NO serial, label, white irregular strokes, printed/text-like marks or microglyphs. Prospective send/receive/time/reconciliation/confirmation relations remain open before implementation. Neutral unlabelled time/calendar/person shapes allowed, no calendar figures, numbers, results or ticks. Exact headline is Ranh giới rõ trước khi triển khai with NO final period. Exact body unchanged. No extra characters or annotations anywhere in scene.
props: entirely plain smooth blank sender record
entirely plain smooth blank receiver record

P2-A4.headline: Ranh giới rõ trước khi triển khai
P2-A4.body: Ghi rõ bên gửi, bên nhận, thời điểm đối chiếu và người xác nhận. Các bên cần xem xét phạm vi kỹ thuật trước khi chọn cách triển khai điểm giao nhận.
